feed.title: My Name is Scibe
feed.subtitle: A collaborative hyperfiction written simultaneously on ARTS WIRE and on The WELL, begun August 17, 1994, while Judy Malloy lay in bed in Tempe, Arizona recovering from a serious accident. Other writers added words about the details of their lives, providing windows on the world for “scibe”. This feed carries the preservation edition’s readings: the title page and all sixty-seven lexias, each read in the voice cast for its writer.
